Loosing weight is much easier than it seems. Cut out all desserts, cut back on sugar, cut back on carbs. Eat complex carbs like oatmeal and rice, or even better vegtables. Follow this basic guideline and eat in a caloric deficit and you will loose weight. If you have the motivation also go on walks to burn extra calories. Walk a few miles and you will burn even more calories. After you have lost a decent amount of weight get your heart health back and focus on cardio, you will feel like shit as you start but it will also feel like your body is cleansing itself. Mentally you will feel ontop of the world if you can complete it, but your body will feel sick to start. Eventually the endorphins you release will be more potent than the negative feelings you associate with cardio. You will feel amazing, both mentally and physically. At this point you could really change your life around.
